title: TechSara ChatGPT Archive managed policy
description: Organization policy delivered through Chrome Enterprise. These values point the extension at the company backend; every capture decision is still made server-side.

apiBaseUrl.title: Backend base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: HTTPS base URL of the company archive backend, e.g. https://archive.example.com

oidcClientId.title: Google OIDC client id used by the extension

managedWorkspaceLabel.title: Managed workspace label shown by ChatGPT

enabled.title: Policy-level enable switch
enabled.description: Setting false disables the extension. Setting true does NOT enable capture: the server-side gates still decide.
